'''Keith Emlese''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Las Vegas Grand Slam]] on 6 May 2000 with Death Star start, according to Brian Garrison's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d724">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-11-las-vegas-baby-yeahd724/ las-vegas-baby-yeah], DeckTech (Brian "bgkenobi" Garrison, 11 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-11-las-vegas-baby-yeahd724/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
